name: Elasticity Slider
description: Fullscreen vertical slideshow driven by wheel, touch or drag, where slides push past each other with stretched image easing. Clicking a slide reveals a text panel behind the image.
contents: Fullscreen slides with image, title and text
Side navigation list of slide titles
Title, scroll hint, go back label and custom cursor label
behavior: Wheel, touch and drag move to the next or previous slide with an elastic vertical stretch
Clicking a slide image slides it up to reveal its text panel, a back button closes it
Navigation items jump to a slide and mark the current one
Custom cursor label follows the mouse with smoothing
Loader pulse shows until images are preloaded

props.name: fontFamily
props.default: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

editableByProps: Slides, titles, texts, images, labels and heading
All colors, font family, timing, easing and scale amounts
Scroll sensitivity, cursor smoothing and offset, navigation and cursor visibility

needsCodeEdit.where: navigate function, yPercent tweens and transformOrigin values

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the frame layout of title, hint and navigation
needsCodeEdit.where: pointer-events-none fixed z-[100] grid block in the returned JSX
slide__content block in the returned JSX

fixed: Root is a fullscreen h-screen block that captures wheel, touch and pointer input through GSAP Observer while mounted
Overlay frame with title, hint and navigation is position fixed over the viewport
Custom cursor follows the mouse and is not shown on touch devices without mouse movement
